metadata.name: The Binding of Isaac Reshaken - Vol 1: Shattered Souls!
metadata.description:
Over a year in the making, Team Milkshake presents to you Volume 1 of Isaac Reshaken!
Isaac Reshaken is a content pack MOD that adds over 40 new high quality items, trinkets, consumables, and foes! Including:
[h1] Features! [/h1] [list] [*] 20+ shiny new items [*] 10+ fancy new spirit orb consumables :0 [*] 10+ tasty new trinkets [*] 4 lustrous new foes [*] 1 mystical new machine type [*] 1000+ new rooms to explore [*] 1 banger new music track [*] 3 creative new challenges [/list]
and loads more surprises! Check out the [url=https://tboireshaken.wiki.gg/wiki/Main_Page]Milkshake Wiki[/url] (WIP) for a full* list!
[h1] Compatibility! [/h1] Alongside all this, we also feature full compatibility with Fiend Folio and several other MODs, creating exciting interactions with them: [list] [*] External Item Descriptions in English, Spanish, Chinese, Russian, Polish, and Korean! [*] DSS setting menu accessible by pressing C [*] Fiend Folio (Full shattered orb enemy elemental support, exclusive FF based rainbow pennies, custom beggar and slot machine interactions with spirit orbs, a full slew of spirit pills matching FF pill colors, fuzzy pickle trinket support, and FF items are available in custom item pools) [*] Epiphany (Support for epiphany beggar and slot machine interactions) [*] Revelations (Full shattered orb enemy element support) [*] Detailed Respawn (Glass idol support) [*] Eclipsed (Spirit orb beggar interactions) [*] Retribution (Full shattered orb enemy element support, spirit orb beggar interactions) [*] Crabby's Cretins (Full shattered orb enemy element support) [*] Immortal Hearts (Custom interaction with leviticus) [*] Library Expanded (Leviticus support) [/list]
[h1] Incompatibilities [/h1] Isaac Reshaken is INCOMPATIBLE with the following mods for one reason or another: [list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2719437566]Double Spiked Rocks[/url] (Crashes in some rooms for unknown reasons...) [/list]
[h1] Only Volume 1?[/h1] Yes! This is only the first volume of several volumes to come! (hopefully) As of now, this expansion does not require Repentogon to run, but future ones will in order to enable many cool possibilities. We hope you look forward to seeing whats in store! Follow Team Milkshake on [url=https://twitter.com/TBOI_Milkshake]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/isaac-reshaken]Tumblr[/url] or join the [url=discord.gg/C9yKHKJ3fx]Isaac Reshaken Discord[/url] to keep up to date on future developments!
[h1] Credits [/h1] This mod wouldn't be possible without the incredible members of Team Milkshake!
